title: 两数相加
statement:
两条非空链表各表示一个非负整数，数字按逆序存放（表头是个位），每个节点存一位数字。求两数之和，并以同样的逆序链表形式返回。除数字 0 本身外，两个数都不含前导零。

节点定义：struct ListNode { int val; ListNode* next; };
constraints: 1 ≤ 每条链表节点数 ≤ 100；0 ≤ 节点值 ≤ 9
表示的数不含前导零（数字 0 本身除外）

complexity.space: O(1) 额外空间，不计输出链表（长度至多 max(m, n) + 1）
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求。
complexity.notes: m、n 为两条链表长度。逐位相加并维护进位，最后若仍有进位需追加一个节点。数字可达 100 位，不能转成内置整数类型再相加。最大测试为官方上限 100 位。

en.title: Add Two Numbers
en.statement:
Two non-empty linked lists each represent a non-negative integer, with digits stored in reverse order (the head holds the ones digit) and one digit per node. Compute the sum of the two numbers and return it as a linked list in the same reversed form. Apart from the number 0 itself, neither number has leading zeros.

Node definition: struct ListNode { int val; ListNode* next; };
constraints: 1 ≤ number of nodes in each list ≤ 100; 0 ≤ node value ≤ 9
The represented numbers have no leading zeros (except the number 0 itself)

complexity.space: O(1) extra space, excluding the output list (length at most max(m, n) + 1)
complexity.notes: m and n are the lengths of the two lists. Add digit by digit while tracking the carry; if a carry remains at the end, append one more node. Numbers can have up to 100 digits, so they cannot be converted to a built-in integer type and added. The largest test uses the official limit of 100 digits.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is m; line 2 has m digits of l1 (ones digit first); line 3 is n; line 4 has n digits of l2. stdout: one line with the digits of the sum (ones digit first), separated by spaces.

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行 m；第二行 m 个数字 l1（个位在前）；第三行 n；第四行 n 个数字 l2。stdout：一行，和的各位数字（个位在前），以空格分隔。
